profile.summary: The Bay Area Community College Consortium is a regional group of 28 community colleges around the San Francisco and Monterey Bays. It supports career education and career pathways and administers regional Strong Workforce Program funding. Its K12 Strong Workforce Program gives grants to Bay Area school districts to create and expand career technical education programs for grades 7-12.
